description: This file defines a class 'VTWS_PreserveGlobal' that manages preservation and restoration of global variables within a PHP application, primarily for API or web service contexts.

classes.name: VTWS_PreserveGlobal
classes.description: A class providing static methods to preserve, restore, get, and flush global variables within the application.

methods.name: preserveGlobal
methods.description: Preserves the current value of a global variable identified by name and sets it to a new value.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a previously preserved global variable to its original value.

methods.name: getGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of a global variable, preserving its state.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Restores all preserved global variables to their original states.
